d11c0b29.task:
Target: http://host.docker.internal:8000

Objective:
Perform thorough reconnaissance and attack surface mapping of the target:
1. Probe the target with httpx/curl, analyze HTTP headers, server fingerprints, technologies, cookies.
2. Crawl the application comprehensively using katana, curl, or scripts. Discover all linked paths, static assets, and client-side scripts.
3. Perform directory and endpoint discovery using ffuf or custom wordlists. Discover unlinked endpoints, API routes, admin portals, docs, etc.
4. Enumerate all entry points, parameters (GET/POST/JSON), forms, authentication mechanisms (login, registration, reset, session cookies/JWT).
5. Document all mapped endpoints, parameters, inputs, and technologies in shared notes using create_note (category="wiki" or "general", tags=["recon", "endpoints"]).
6. Record coverage for scanned attack surfaces using record_coverage.
7. Call agent_finish with a comprehensive summary of all discovered endpoints, technologies, and candidate attack surfaces. Do NOT attempt deep exploit execution or PoC building yourself — map everything so specialized hunters can test each vector.
